## 席位核对
ACCEPT — L1 by area s2-C (order s2-area-order.md item 9) at head e6db997232d36582fdfed961e6f2697339a92045 · card #36481 · 2026-11-23T00:16Z

- Shape: `l1-face.mjs --pr 36572` CLEAN: draft, base `main`, `Fixes #36481` after the two attribution lines, no closing keyword near another card; changeset `@object-ui/app-shell` + `@object-ui/i18n` (patch), read sentence by sentence against the diff: two note kinds, ruling 6631250894's order unchanged, Save writes no translation row, two new studio keys — all match. `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`; the dev measured the built `dist/namespaces/studio/en.d.ts` (`Record<string, string>`), so the two new keys move no published type.
- Premise and route: premise held (claim 7086903287). Route 2 (note) was taken because route 1 was measured out: the only console translation-row write is the All metadata translation form editor (whole-locale bundle records), and the server merges every bundle before translating, so the console cannot tell which row answers a slot without a new server read — the claim's stop condition for route 1.
- Gates: check-runs at e6db99723 — 45 success · 13 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending; Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check `success`. Local: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (`/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/36481-gates-ran.txt`). Ablation: `servedLabelNote` returning `null` ⇒ 7 of 13 red (every note case), 6 controls green; restored to HEAD.
- Spot reads: `servedLabel.ts` — `servedLabelNote` judges only the served/authored pair: `kept` when the published label has its own entry for the language and another text is served; `ifKept` only when no entry exists, a translation is served and the box holds an edit (an untouched box shows nothing). `ReportDefaultInspector.tsx` / `DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx` — the note renders under the box with `role="note"`; the widget title input is wired by `aria-describedby`.
- Accepted: the `ifKept` wording is conditional because the pair cannot tell the package's own bundle from the environment's or the pair's (dev open question 1 → option A, as the card's done-when allows "or the panel showed the note before Save"). Live zh-CN round trip NOT MEASURED (no live stack); the 13 pins run both card cases through the hosts' own pairing functions. Nits, not defects: the report input is not `aria-describedby`-wired (shared `InspectorTextField`, outside the surface); the widget note uses a fixed element id.
- Out of scope: an inline map whose entry equals its base's, plus a bundle translation, would show a wrong `kept` — #36373's census found 0 such maps on these slots; in the PR's Acceptance notes, not filed.
- Landing: not governed (0 of 7 paths), 426 changed lines; main is 5 commits past the merge base, touching the studio `en.ts`/`zh.ts` (other keys); GitHub reads `mergeable_state: clean` and the queue re-tests the merged tree. Area lands it: ready + auto-merge in this stroke.
